verdict.rationale: An agency that offers online employer services could plausibly publish a developer API reference, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains no interactive API reference, no runnable examples, and no developer portal, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs at standard paths all returned 404. The documented FSET/EFT filing and payment channels are transactional services, not an explorable API reference, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
